items.exampleEn: He is still bitter about losing his job.

items.sentenceZh: 孩子透過觀察父母學會守規矩。

items.sentenceEn: I can't forgive myself for breaking her favorite cup.

items.stemEn: What a ____! The concert was canceled.
Please ____ yourself; there are important guests here today.
items.stemZh: 請注意你的言行，今天有重要的客人。

items.passageEn: When I was ten, I broke my neighbor's window with a ball. I was scared, so I ran home and did not tell anyone. For days, I felt guilt and shame. Eventually, I went to the neighbor and said sorry. To my surprise, he forgave me and even gave me praise for being honest. He said that he felt no anger about the window. Since that day, I have been conscious of my actions, and I always try to behave well.
items.passageZh: 我十歲那年，用球打破了鄰居家的窗戶。我很害怕，所以跑回家，誰也沒說。好幾天我都覺得又內疚又羞愧。最後，我去找鄰居道歉。出乎意料，他原諒了我，還稱讚我誠實。他說他一點也不為窗戶的事生氣。從那天起，我就很注意自己的行為，也總是努力守規矩。

questions.questionZh: 作者打破窗戶後先做了什麼？

options: 原諒他，還稱讚他很誠實

items.promptZh: 這部電影受到影評人的高度讚美。
referenceEn: This movie received high praise from critics.
The movie got high praise from the critics.
rubricZh: 用 praise（名詞）表示「讚美」（例如 received high praise；寫 was highly praised by critics 也正確）
「影評人」可寫，例如 critics、movie critics 等

items.promptZh: 這杯咖啡太苦了，我喝不下去。
referenceEn: This coffee is too bitter for me to drink.
This coffee is so bitter that I can't drink it.
rubricZh: 用 bitter 表示「（味道）苦的」（例如 too bitter、so bitter 等）
「喝不下去」可寫，例如 too … for me to drink、so … that I can't drink it 等
